detail.title: SA75RDPT | 7.5 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine (Red & White | Grey & White)
detail.overview: The Intex SA75RDPT 7.5 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine is designed for efficiency, durability, and powerful cleaning. Its anti-corrosive, rust-free body ensures longevity, while the 3-fins pulsator and scrubber technology provide deep cleaning action for stubborn stains. The hydraulic wash lid allows for smooth operation, and the powerful motor ensures noise-free spinning for faster drying. With an easy-to-use water level indicator, a lint filter to keep clothes fresh, and an end-cycle buzzer for convenience, this washing machine makes laundry effortless.
